{{Quote|Those who go beyond the Forbidden Pass are never seen again.|Sharack Breev|<ref name="TOR:GitD">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Warrior|Guru in the Dunes|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''Forbidden Pass''' was a gap in the western side of the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that allowed access to the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. Some natives like [[Sharack Breev]] were afraid of the Pass and never ventured beyond it, unaware of what lay beyond.<ref name="TOR:GitD" />
